title: Inverse proper exchange of the ordinary constant-object units
statement: For finite commutative A and a Cartesian square v:Yprime -> Y, gprime:Yprime -> Zprime, g:Y -> Z and w:Zprime -> Z with g proper, the constant-object unit for gprime followed by ordinary direct image along gprime of inverse constant pullback along v, followed by inverse proper exchange at the constant object on Y, equals inverse constant pullback along w followed by pullback along w of the constant-object unit for g. This is the inverse form of the ordinary unit base-change square.

source.place: The equation M = Rp2_* Delta_* M, the diagonal is a section for either projection, and substitution of canonical pullback counits before applying direct image.

proof.text: Apply ordinary constant-object base change to the Cartesian square. Proper exchange and constant-object pullback are isomorphisms. Their composite isomorphism has hom equal to exchange followed by direct image of the constant pullback hom. Cancel this composite on the right and the constant pullback isomorphism on the left. Expand the inverse composite and functor map of an inverse.

theorem constantUnit_inverseProperExchange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {Y Y' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    {g : Y ⟶ Z} {g' : Y' ⟶ Z'} {v : Y' ⟶ Y} {w : Z' ⟶ Z}
    [IsProper g] (sq : IsPullback v g' g w) :
    supportedDerivedUnit A g' ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A g').map (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A v).inv ≫
        (properExchange A sq).inv.app (ordinaryFiniteUnit A Y) =
      (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A w).inv ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A w).map (supportedDerivedUnit A g)
